#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'Usage: bash build-on-board.sh /absolute/path/to/lab-st-2026' >&2; exit 2; fi
project_dir=$(realpath -- "$1")
test -f "$project_dir/common/touch_protocol.c"
record_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/build-lab4-XXXXXX")
make -B -C "$project_dir/lab4" CC=gcc CFLAGS='-Wall -O3' 2>&1 | tee "$record_dir/build.log"
file "$project_dir/out/lab4"
if(w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
#include <limits.h>
if((w<0)||(h<0) || w > INT_MAX/4) return NULL;

if(line_byte < 0 || (h > 0 && (size_t)line_byte > (SIZE_MAX-sizeof(fb_image))/(size_t)h)) return NULL;
	image = (fb_image *)malloc(sizeof(fb_image) + (size_t)line_byte*h);

((int64_t)x+w > img->pixel_w)||
		((int64_t)y+h > img->pixel_h))
ret->content = img->content + (size_t)y*img->line_byte + x;

if(slot->bitmap.rows && slot->bitmap.pitch > 0)
		memcpy(image->content, slot->bitmap.buffer, (size_t)slot->bitmap.rows * slot->bitmap.pitch);
CC := gcc
EXESRCS += ../common/graphic.c ../common/touch.c ../common/touch_protocol.c ../common/image.c ../common/task.c
int touch_read(int fd, int *x, int *y, int *finger)

#include "drawing.h"
int main(int argc, char **argv)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then echo 'Usage: bash run-lab.sh /absolute/path/lab-st-2026 lab3|lab4|lab5_bt|test [program options]' >&2; exit 2; fi
project_dir=$(realpath -- "$1")
lab=$2
shift 2
case "$lab" in lab3|lab4|lab5_bt|test) ;; *) echo 'Unknown lab' >&2; exit 2;; esac
tool_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
check_options=()
remaining=("$@")
for ((i=0; i<${#remaining[@]}; i++)); do
    case "${remaining[$i]}" in
        --touch|--serial)
            if ((i+1>=${#remaining[@]})); then echo 'Missing device path' >&2; exit 2; fi
            check_options+=("${remaining[$i]}" "${remaining[$((i+1))]}"); i=$((i+1));;
        --headless) check_options+=(--headless);;
    esac
done
python3 "$tool_dir/preflight.py" --project "$project_dir" --lab "$lab" "${check_options[@]}"
run_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/run-$lab-XXXXXX")
cd -- "$project_dir/out"
echo "Log: $run_dir/run.log"
set +e
"./$lab" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$run_dir/run.log"
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
printf '\nProgram exit status: %d\n' "$status" | tee -a "$run_dir/run.log"
exit "$status"
